name: 陳岡伯
objective: n the second semester, apart from further refining students' writing skills (in the modes of classification and extended definition), the course will also introduce key theoretical approaches in literary and cultural studies to help students establish their arguments and methodologies of their senior projects. Students will read excerpts from original theoretical texts and critical essays that involve theoretical frameworks and write a full research paper at the end of the semester.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to the course and reviewing the common errors/defects in the 2 essays written in last semester  
Week 2: Classification essay: exercise  
Week 3: Extended definition: exercise
Week 4: Introduction to theories, methods of critical reading
Week 5: Introduction to psychoanalysis
Week 6: Exercise: psychoanalytical readings of "The Black Cat"
Week 7: Exercise: psychoanalytical readings of "The Garden of Love"
Week 8: Gender studies: introduction to feminism
Week 9: Film viewing: Thelma & Louise
Week 10: Exercise: feminist readings of Thelma & Louise
Week 11: Gender studies: introduction to queer theory
Week 12: Film viewing: The Birdcage 
Week 13: Exercise: queer readings of The Birdcage
Week 14: Introduction to postcolonial studies: Orientalism, the subaltern 
Week 15: Film viewing: M. Butterfly
Week 16: Exercise: postcolonial readings of M. Butterfly
Week 17-18: Individual presentations
materials:
All materials will be provided by the instructor.

Theoretical texts:
Sigmund Freud, "The Ego and the Id," "The Ego and the Super-Ego"
Simone de Beauvoir, "Introduction" to The Second Sex
Michel Foucault, Excerpts from Discipline and Punish
Edward Said, "Introduction" to Orientalism

Films for discussion:
Thelma & Louis
The Birdcage 
M. Butterfly
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
